name: Frozen Bodies grants a stack from a minion's critical Frost attack (#9977)
contract: Frozen Bodies 707562 reads 'When you kill an enemy that yields experience or honor or critically strike
with Frost damage you now gain a stack of Frozen Bodies.' aura_ascension_necromancer_event::Proc only checked
the crit-frost branch inside its 'own' block (actor == player), never inside its 'minion' block (actor is an
owned minion), so a Skeletal Mage's own Frost auto-attack (801513) critically striking never granted a
stack. The Necromancer here pulls a dummy with a Physical melee swing only (no Frost cast of its own, so the
'own' branch cannot grant a stack) while a raised Skeletal Mage (50075) fights the same dummy with its Frost
auto-attack; spell_crit_rating 10000 makes every spell crit, including the minion's inherited Frost spell
onto the minion's m_baseSpellCritChance every second), so the Mage's very next 801513 cast must be a critical
hit and must grant exactly the stack the report says never appeared.

steps.label: SETUP: the Necromancer has Frozen Bodies
CONTROL: no Frozen Bodies stack before any Frost crit lands
SETUP: a Skeletal Mage is raised
Let the Mage take its formation place
Pull the dummy with a Physical melee swing (never Frost-schooled)
Let the Mage's Frost auto-attack crit and resolve the proc
DISCRIMINATING: the minion's Frost crit grants a Frozen Bodies stack
